About Us

Generations of Trust in Sargodha

The story of a family goldsmith that has served Sarafa Bazar, Sargodha since 1985.

Our Story

From One Workshop to a Trusted Name

SM Gold was founded in 1985 by Master Goldsmith Muhammad Saleem, who started with a small workshop in the heart of Sargodha. What began as a one-man operation has grown into one of the most trusted gold shops in Sarafa Bazar.

For nearly four decades, we have served thousands of families, crafting jewelry for weddings, celebrationsand precious moments. Our commitment to purity, fair pricingand exceptional craftsmanship has made us a trusted goldsmith in Sargodha often called the best jewellery shop in Sargodha by the families we’ve served for generationsand the goldsmith near you in Sarafa Bazar whenever you need one.

Why It Matters

Gold in Sargodha & Pakistan

A few reasons gold stays central to life hereand why we’ve built SM Gold around trust rather than trends.

◆

A City That Runs on Gold

Sargodha district is home to over 4.3 million people (2023 census)and for most families here, gold is still the traditional way to save, giftand mark life’s biggest occasions weddings, birthsand Eid among them.

◆

A Market Worth Protecting

Pakistan’s jewellery market is valued at roughly $1.33 billion (2024) and growing, with gold jewellery remaining the single most requested item at weddings nationwide exactly why purity and fair pricing matter as much as design.

◆

Prices That Move Daily

Gold prices in Pakistan can shift within the same day, tracking international rates and the rupee exchange rate. That’s why we recalculate and post our board rates fresh every day, rather than leaving old numbers up.

◆

Found When You Need Us

Most people searching for a gold shop near me or jewellers near me visit within a day of searching, usually from their phone. That’s part of why we stay open 24 hours and keep our WhatsApp line active for quick replies.

Sources: Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, 2023 Census (Sargodha district population); industry market research on Pakistan’s jewellery sector, 2024–2025.
